records.label: spacr.qt.bridge.make_thread#3
records.source: A handle is added to :func:`registry` before this function returns, while the thread is still unstarted. It remains registered until ``thread.finished`` invokes the handle's retirement method. Registered handles therefore include jobs awaiting start or retirement; they are not a count of threads currently executing. Surfaces such as Home can use these handles to show jobs they did not start. Retirement is connected to ``thread.finished`` rather than ``worker.finished``, which is emitted before the thread stops.
records.context: A handle is added to :func:`registry` before this function returns, while the independent execution path is still unstarted. It remains registered until ``thread.finished`` invokes the handle's retirement method. Registered handles therefore include jobs awaiting start or retirement; they are not a count of independent execution paths currently executing. Surfaces such as Home can use these handles to show jobs they did not start. Retirement is connected to ``thread.finished`` rather than ``worker.finished``, which is emitted before the independent execution path stops.
records.translation: Ett handtag läggs till i :func:`registry` innan denna funktion returnerar, medan tråden ännu inte har startats. Det förblir registrerat tills ``thread.finished`` anropar handtagets avregistreringsmetod. Registrerade handtag omfattar därför jobb som väntar på start eller avregistrering; de är inte ett antal trådar som körs just nu. Vyer som Home kan använda dessa handtag för att visa jobb de inte själva startade. Avregistrering kopplas till ``thread.finished`` i stället för ``worker.finished``, som skickas innan tråden stannar.
